# HavokOS M4 (efuns) on the real mudlib: Dead Souls 3.9's own simul_efuns
# (/secure/sefun/*.c), which are LPC built almost entirely on the efun
# library -- sprintf column/centre/pad formats, explode/implode,
# replace_string, sscanf, regexp, sort_array, member_array, mappings, ...
# Both drivers boot DS3.9 as far as its simul_efun object (no master, no
# preloads), so only sefuns that don't need the object model (M5) are here.
# One case per line, <name><TAB><body>; expected results in
# m4_ds.expected.txt are the live reference's (tools/ref_cases.pike -ds).
#
# --- strings.c
center	return ({ center("abc", 11), center("abcdef", 4), center("%^RED%^ab%^RESET%^", 10) });
arrange_string	return ({ arrange_string("abc", 6), arrange_string("abcdefgh", 4) });
trim	return ({ trim("  a b  "), trim("\tx\t"), trim("nospace") });
space_trim	return space_trim("a  b   c    d");
newline_trim	return newline_trim("\\n\\nab\\n\\n");
wrap with width	return ({ wrap("the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog", 12), wrap("short", 20) });
reverse_string	return ({ reverse_string("abc"), reverse_string("") });
starts_with	return ({ starts_with("abcdef", "abc"), starts_with("abcdef", "x"), starts_with_arr("abc", ({ "x", "ab" })) });
last first truncate	return ({ last("abcdef", 2), first("abcdef", 2), truncate("abcdef", 2) });
grepp memberp	return ({ grepp("hello world", "wor"), grepp("hello", "z"), memberp(({ 1, 2 }), 2), reverse_memberp("abc", ({ "x", "b" })) });
first last element	return ({ last_string_element("a/b/c", "/"), first_string_element("a/b/c", "/"), path_prefix("/a/b/c.c") });
alpha numeric	return ({ alphap("abc"), alphap("ab1"), alpha_strip("a1b2-c"), numericp("123"), numericp("12a"), basic_punctuationp("."), basic_punctuationp("a") });
chunk_string	return ({ chunk_string("abcdefghij", 3), chunk_string("ab", 5) });
morse	return ({ morse("sos"), unmorse(morse("hello")) });
convert_string	return ({ convert_string("12"), convert_string("\\"str\\""), convert_string("({ 1, 2 })"), convert_string("([ \\"a\\" : 1 ])"), convert_string("-5"), convert_string("1.5") });
convert_newline	return convert_newline("a\\nb");
cleaned	return ({ cleaned_name("Bob the Great"), cleaned_end("hello!!!") });
# --- english.c
add_article	return ({ add_article("apple"), add_article("sword"), add_article("sword", 1), add_article("hour"), add_article("Unicorn") });
remove_article	return ({ remove_article("a sword"), remove_article("the apple"), remove_article("an egg"), remove_article("sword") });
explode_list	return ({ explode_list("a, b and c"), explode_list("x"), explode_list("one and two") });
# item_list() walks a mapping, so with several distinct items its word order
# is the mapping's iteration order: Pike's hash order in the reference,
# insertion order here (NOTES.md deviation #9); only order-free inputs
item_list	return ({ item_list(({ "a sword" })), item_list(({ "a sword", "a sword" })), item_list(({ "a sword", "a sword", "a sword" })) });
possessive	return ({ possessive_noun("Bob"), possessive_noun("Chris"), possessive_noun("it") });
ds pluralize	return ({ pluralize("sword"), pluralize("box"), pluralize("a sword"), pluralize("mouse"), pluralize("bag of gold") });
cardinal	return ({ cardinal(0), cardinal(1), cardinal(13), cardinal(42), cardinal(100), cardinal(1234), cardinal(-7) });
conjunction	return ({ conjunction(({ "a" })), conjunction(({ "a", "b" })), conjunction(({ "a", "b", "c" })), conjunction(({ "a", "b", "c" }), "or") });
consolidate	return ({ consolidate(1, "a sword"), consolidate(3, "a sword"), consolidate(2, "an apple"), consolidate(5, "the orc") });
ordinalp	return ({ ordinalp("first"), ordinalp("third"), ordinalp("seventh"), ordinalp("sword") });
# --- numbers.c, ordinal.c, percent.c
comma	return ({ comma(0), comma(999), comma(1000), comma(1234567), comma(-1234), comma("12345") });
atoi itoa	return ({ atoi("42"), atoi("x"), itoa(5), itoa("7") });
ordinal	return ({ ordinal(1), ordinal(2), ordinal(3), ordinal(4), ordinal(11), ordinal(12), ordinal(13), ordinal(21), ordinal(22), ordinal(101), ordinal(111) });
percent	return ({ percent(1, 4), percent(3, 3), percent(0, 7), percent(1, 3) });
bool_reverse	return ({ bool_reverse(0), bool_reverse(5) });
# --- format_page.c needs this_player() (the object model, M5)
# --- arrays.c, mappings.c, copy.c, absolute_value.c
compare arrays	return ({ sizeof(scramble_array(({ 1, 2, 3, 4 }))), sort_array(scramble_array(({ 3, 1, 2 })), 1) });
mappings	return ({ sort_array(keys(add_maps(([ "a": 1 ]), ([ "b": 2 ]))), 1) });
absolute_value	return ({ absolute_value(-5), absolute_value(3), absolute_value(-2.5) });
# --- absolute_path.c
absolute_path	return ({ absolute_path("/a/b", "c"), absolute_path("/a/b", "../c"), absolute_path("/a/b", "/x/y"), absolute_path("/a/b", "./c/./d"), absolute_path("/", "z") });
